tasks.title: The Mine Layer crosses sideways ahead of the player laying curved or zig-zag mine lines one pass at a time, builds danger gradually, and punishes chasers
tasks.description: Implement the pass AI in MineLayerBrain (plan §2.12). Player frame: P, smoothed v̄ (0.5 s), moving when |v̄| >= 60. A moving player's f = v̄/|v̄| is read every tick; a STANDING player's f is LATCHED to the unit vector from P toward the layer at APPROACH start (and on every moving->standing switch) and kept until the plan freezes, and the sign of u is latched with the frame (S on the layer's side; on a tie the side the layer's velocity points to, else +1). Re-reading f every tick made the run-in point turn with the layer and the plan never froze. Pass geometry: mines on the vertices (ZIGZAG step 100 / amplitude 35, ARC depth 110, six mines, 600 px pass), run-in point R = S - u*150. Two plan forms: FENCE (standing player, and the fence fallback): C = P + f*320, with the Open Space spread by rotating C about P by +theta, -theta, +2theta, -2theta, theta = 2*asin(min(1, 390 / (2*|C - P|))), the rotation turning the latched f and u with it; LEAD (moving player): the Ph4 earliest-feasible arrival scan (BomberBrain._solve_arrival's shape: T scanned in ARRIVAL_SCAN_STEP 0.1 s up to lead_scan_cap 6.0, then ARRIVAL_BISECTIONS 5; constants declared in MineLayerBrain) with t_lead(T) = T + run_in/lay_speed + min(c, 3.0), C(T) = P + v̄*t_lead(T) + f*(260 + shift), feasibility flight_time(R) = |R - pos|/max_speed + (max_speed - v0)^2/(2*acceleration*max_speed) <= T (v0 = own speed toward R, >= 0); Open Space spread for the lead form shifts C ALONG the player's heading (shift 0, then 390), never rotates it; no feasible candidate -> the fence fallback, frozen at once (fence_fallbacks + 1); a later tick of the same APPROACH that loses feasibility freezes the last feasible plan as it stands. The candidate is chosen on the first plan of each APPROACH and latched with the frame. The plan freezes within commit_distance 200 of R. APPROACH: seek R at max_speed; hand over to the run-in when within path_lookahead 60 px of R; the run-in pursues along R -> S at lay_speed; LAY starts when the centre's projection on u CROSSES S from the R side (< 0 to >= 0). The Open Space approach_max_seconds 6.0 s backstop takes the fence fallback. No-stacking; Assault: no scan, horizontal axis, C = (P.x, P.y - 220), view-rect clamp grow(-174). APPROACH -> LAY -> BREAK_OFF -> REPOSITION in Open Space (one pass then DISENGAGE in Assault; DISENGAGE keeps the shell's release_constraint()), the Dispenser 'plus' drop rule, the stall guard and budget deferral, the tail drop, and the FIFO live cap with retire(). Add the pass config fields (including lead_scan_cap) and the §2.12 test seams (pass_form, plan_frozen, frame_f, arrival_time, flight_time(), spread_fallbacks, fence_fallbacks, freeze_plan(), ...). Measure GUT with scripts/gate-time.sh before and after and report both (and in tests/README.md -> Gate time); stay within this task's allotment in plan §2.17. bash /agent/verify.sh green; scripts/check-test-leaks.sh clean if anything awaits. Append 'built in tN' notes and any deviation to the Phase 7 section of DECISIONS.md.

Standing stub, layer at rest 600 px away at bearings 0/90/180 deg: plan frozen within 2.5 s, fence_fallbacks 0, frame_f and the run-in point unchanged from APPROACH start to the freeze, C 320 +-2 px from the stub toward the layer. Lead: a 100 px/s stub with the layer 600 px ahead freezes a lead plan within 2.5 s with fence_fallbacks 0, C on the stub's track line (<= 2 px) and more than 80 px ahead of the live stub when the middle mine arms; abeam (90 deg) also a lead plan within 5.0 s. The scan row (T earliest within 0.004 s) and the lost-feasibility guard row (layer teleported 1500 px behind before the freeze -> last plan kept and frozen, fence_fallbacks unchanged). Reversing stub -> line where planned. Fence fallback: layer 600 px behind a 220 px/s stub -> frozen fence plan on the first planning tick, fence_fallbacks 1, C 320 +-2 px from the stub toward the layer, LAY reached; control (the 100 px/s lead row) -> 0. Run-in: handover on the first tick within 60 px of R; LAY starts on the tick the centre's projection crosses S (from < 0 to >= 0), never before, with no drop before it. From S on, LAY velocity within 40 deg of the axis and centre within 40 px of the polyline, for an aligned arrival AND for a frozen plan with the layer 300 px from R along the normal moving at 240 px/s (also with an earlier pass nearby). >= 6.2 s from the end of a LAY to the next; <= 6 mines a pass; in both 60 s scenarios (standing stub; stub at 120 px/s on a 700 px circle) every plan that did not take the spread fallback is >= 380 px from the earlier live pass centres, and the standing scenario has fence_fallbacks 0. The pure plan_pass() spread rows: fence +2theta chosen at 150.2 deg with frame_f rotated; fence with no legal candidate -> spread_fallbacks + 1; lead with an earlier centre at the unshifted C -> the +390 shift along f, still on the track line. Live cap 18 with the 19th retiring the oldest; one pass per Assault life (DISENGAGE with constraint_released()) completing within the stall guard when the budget expires mid-LAY; the tail-drop row and its in-front control; accepts_tow(); in APPROACH (run-in included), REPOSITION and DISENGAGE the layer keeps > 100 px from every live mine of passes other than the one currently planned, excluding LAY, BREAK_OFF and tail-drop mines.
